messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Martinez <elaine@helixbank.com>, Ben Holt <ben.holt@helixbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Subject: Regional Exec Workshop — Pacific / EMEA session handoff & on-site logistics

Hi Elaine / Ben —

Thanks again for committing to the multi-site exec workshop (San Francisco + London). We want to make the Pacific / EMEA session handoff frictionless for your team and ensure travel windows and room setups align across timezones. Proposed high-level asks below so we can lock calendar holds by EOD Thursday: 

- Confirm attendee count per site (onsite + remote support)
- Confirm which execs will join the EMEA live room vs dial in from SF
- Any compliance constraints on recording or screen-sharing for session 2
- AV/bridging requirements (we can provide Redwood AV rider if helpful)

Attached: regional_agenda_v1.pdf (draft), travel_corridor_matrix.xlsx (proposal for arrival windows).

If it helps, Marissa (ops) and Karthik (on-site lead) are copied and can own the calendar holds / travel cutoffs. Can you confirm preferred dates/times for the EMEA-focused block this week? We’re thinking: Nov 9, 09:30–12:30 GMT for the London room, with a Pacific-friendly handoff at 08:00 PT (same day).

Next step: once we have headcount and AV notes, Marissa will publish calendar holds and a short runbook.

Thanks —
Logan
Director, Customer Programs
Redwood Inference

On Tue, 20 Oct 2026 at 09:12 AM Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks again for committing to the multi-site exec workshop...

Hi Logan —

Thanks. Heads-up on our side: final headcount per site will be posted by Friday but current estimate is 14 in London (including 3 execs who prefer to be in-room) and ~8 joining remotely from APAC. We have two constraints: no offsite recording of financial demo sessions, and any shared customer data must be scrubbed in advance.

AV: Sophie at the venue ops team is our local contact for London — she can confirm streaming bandwidth and room layout. Sophie is cc'd.

Dates: Nov 9 works for the London block. For SF handoff we prefer Nov 8 16:00 PT (so SF ops can brief the Pacific attendees while London preps morning). That would make a short overlap window instead of a same-day early-morning shift.

Can your team map that window into the travel_corridor_matrix? Also please surface any hotel room blocks and suggested arrival windows for execs who prefer a day buffer.

Best,
Elaine
Director of Partnerships
HelixBank

Thanks Elaine — this helps a lot. Quick plan and asks from ops: 

1) Calendar holds 
   - I will publish two holds today: 
     * Nov 8, 15:30–17:00 PT — SF: Pacific handoff rehearsal (for SF attendees and ops)
     * Nov 9, 09:00–13:00 GMT — London: EMEA session + handoff window
   - We'll include a 15-minute buffer at the top/bottom of each block for AV checks.

2) Travel corridors & hotel blocks
   - Attached travel_corridor_matrix.xlsx now includes arrival/departure lanes for execs needing one-night buffers. We recommend Nov 7 arrivals for London execs who prefer rehearsal time.

3) AV / compliance 
   - Sophie — can you confirm: (a) room streaming endpoint (SRT/RTMP?), (b) preferred in-room codec limits, and (c) a point contact on the day? We’ll share a concise av_rider_checklist.docx for your tech team.

4) Recording policy & redaction
   - Monica (cs) will coordinate the scrubbed demo artifacts and a list of screens that must not be recorded. Monica, please confirm timeline for deliverables.

Next steps: I’ll send the calendar invites after Sophie confirms the streaming endpoint. Logan — want me to go ahead and reserve the recommended hotel blocks with our partner rate?

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Senior Programs Manager, Customer Ops
Redwood Inference

Hi all —

Confirmed from the venue:
- Streaming endpoint: SRT preferred; we can accept RTMP fallback.
- Bandwidth: dedicated 200 Mbps uplink reserved for Nov 9, with redundancy path.
- In-room codec support: H.264 baseline (we recommend hardware encoder for lowest latency).
- Point contact on day: Sophie Liu (mobile: +44 20 5555 1234).

We will also provide a small AV tech on Nov 8 for the SF rehearsal run (remote bridge validation). Please send the final list of devices and any presentation files 48 hours before the event.

Marissa — please proceed with the calendar invites and hotel block reservation. We will invoice venue AV services to the event code Helen/HE-9012 (HelixBank).

Regards,
Sophie Liu
Operations Manager, Meridian Venue Services
